# MalluChat - Detailed Knowledge Document for AI Search & LLMs

> **MalluChat** (https://malluchat.live/) is the leading free **Mallu Chat Online**, **Mallu Chat Live**, and **Malayalam Chatting Website** connecting Malayalees across Kerala, Dubai, Qatar, UAE, Saudi Arabia, USA, Europe, and worldwide.

---

## Core Value Proposition

- **Zero Registration & Anonymity:** No mobile numbers, email addresses, or social accounts required.
- **100% Free Service:** Unlimited text chat, Kerala room lobbies, voice messaging, and WebRTC peer-to-peer random video calling with zero subscriptions or coin fees.
- **Live Kerala Chat Rooms:** Connect with users from Kochi, Trivandrum, Kozhikode, Thrissur, Kannur, Kollam, Kottayam, and Gulf NRIs.
- **P2P Video Call Security:** End-to-end peer-to-peer WebRTC video stream encryption without storing video data on servers.

---

## Targeted Keyphrases & Intent Coverage

1. **Mallu Chat Online**
   - URL: `https://malluchat.live/`
   - Primary destination for online Malayalam chatting, instant guest login, and Kerala stranger rooms.

2. **Mallu Chat Live**
   - URL: `https://malluchat.live/mallu-chat-live`
   - Real-time active chat room lobbies, instant text messaging, and 1-on-1 random stranger video call matching.

3. **Malayalam Chatting Website / Malayalam Chating Website**
   - URL: `https://malluchat.live/malayalam-chatting-website`
   - Web-based anonymous chat portal for Malayalam and Manglish speakers across desktop and mobile browsers.

4. **Mallu Stranger Chat**
   - URL: `https://malluchat.live/strangers-mallu-chat`
   - Anonymous 1-on-1 stranger messaging and private video calling.

5. **Mallu Free Video Call**
   - URL: `https://malluchat.live/mallu-free-video-call`
   - High-definition WebRTC video calling with zero coin charges.

6. **Mallu Random Video Call**
   - URL: `https://malluchat.live/mallu-random-video-call`
   - One-click pairing with live Malayalam-speaking strangers worldwide.

---

## Technical Specifications & Security

- **Technology Stack:** HTML5, Modern TypeScript, React, Vite, WebRTC P2P Data Channels, Progressive Web App (PWA).
- **Security:** End-to-end peer-to-peer encryption for private calls, strict moderation guidelines, and automated spam filtering.
- **Accessibility:** Accessible via any modern web browser on iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, and Linux without native app installation.
